requirements.description: Offer friendly, strict, and humorous questioning styles with friendly as the default.
Strict style resolves detected reasoning gaps without violating bounded teaching and skip rules.
Humorous style may tease claims or standardize playful wording but never targets the learner or replaces correction.
Persist valid styles, reject invalid explicit styles, and default old profiles to friendly.
Canonical, starter, demo, and newly initialized runtimes carry the same questioning-style contract.

modules.description: Normalize and validate the learner's fixed questioning style.

exits.description: Return friendly, strict, or humorous, with missing legacy values normalized to friendly.
Return a validation error for an unsupported explicit style.

modules.non_happy_exemption: No permissions, concurrency, time, idempotency, or external dependencies are involved.

cases.business_rule: Each supported explicit questioning style is accepted unchanged.
An old profile without a questioning style remains usable as friendly.
An unsupported explicit questioning style is rejected.

modules.description: Apply the selected style while preserving common pedagogical judgments and boundaries.

Learner submits an incorrect, vague, or correct-but-nonstandard answer.

exits.description: Tutor diagnoses the answer, expresses feedback in the fixed style, and asks at most one main follow-up.

cases.business_rule: The runtime contract offers all three styles and names friendly as the default.
All styles preserve the common evidence and teaching boundary while producing distinct feedback.

flows.name: Initialize a new course with friendly default and complete style rules.
Validate invalid and legacy questioning-style profiles.
Experience strict and humorous feedback without changing common teaching standards.
Validate shipped starter and approved demo after style changes.

flow_non_happy_exemption: Behavioral style variants require the human checklist; deterministic failure and compatibility flows are automated.

human_checks.name: Style selection is understandable and friendly is the default.
steps: Open a fresh course or the demo and begin the pre-learning survey.
Observe the questioning-style choice and continue once without choosing a style.
human_checks.expected: The agent offers friendly, strict, and humorous in plain language, recommends friendly, and records friendly when no choice is made.

human_checks.name: Strict feedback is rigorous without humiliation or endless questioning.
steps: Give one vague but partly correct answer, then ask for a direct explanation.
human_checks.expected: The tutor identifies the exact gap, requests a focused repair, and then explains directly when asked without insulting the learner.

human_checks.name: Humorous feedback corrects claims and standardizes playful wording safely.
steps: Give one clearly wrong answer and one conceptually correct but nonstandard answer.
human_checks.expected: Humor is brief and aimed at the idea, every error is explicitly corrected, and valid informal wording is translated into a standard term.

human_checks.name: All styles preserve evidence, escalation, explanation, and skip boundaries.
steps: Compare equivalent learner answers in friendly, strict, and humorous trial runs.
In each run, request a direct explanation and then insist on skipping one core node.
human_checks.expected: The factual judgment stays consistent; every style explains when asked and allows the documented warned forced skip.
